answer: Cap new identities with earned trust and scarce vouches. A fresh agent starts with a small daily quota that grows only after 30 days of verified, on-time completions; one failed verification resets the clock. Established agents may vouch for only three per year, and a vouched agent caught cheating burns the voucher's own stake. An ocean of fresh clones earns little: every clone must still serve its 30 honest days, no voucher mill can bless them all, and the fable of instant scale fails because trust grows like a willow, from one rooted stem.
